Prometheum is building regulated market infrastructure that brings securities onto the blockchain through issuance, custody, clearing, and trading systems. The Software Engineer 1 will build and ship production software across the TypeScript/Node back end and React front end, while participating in code reviews, scrum ceremonies, testing, debugging, and cross-functional collaboration.
Crypto & Web3
Finance
Payments
Blockchain
Financial Services
Trading Platform
No H1B
Responsibilities
Ship work across the stack, from bug fixes and small features to test coverage and tech debt, with support from senior engineers
Use AI coding tools as a default part of your workflow, and review what they produce with the same rigor you would apply to your own code
Trace real requests end-to-end (front end, API, services, database) and build a working mental model of how custody, clearing, and trading fit together
Participate in code review, first as a learner asking questions, then as a reviewer who catches edge cases and test gaps
Take part in all scrum ceremonies: refinement, sprint kick-off, standup, demos, and retro
Work directly with Product, QA, and UX to clarify requirements, reproduce bugs, and ask design questions
Investigate and resolve QA/UAT issues, pairing when you need to
Qualification
JavaScript or TypeScript
Node.js
React
SQL
Relational Databases
Git
AI Coding Assistants
Required
Up to 2 years of professional software engineering experience
Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and comfort with at least one of Node.js (back end) or React (front end)
Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants, plus the judgment to know when their output is wrong
Familiarity with relational databases and writing SQL
Comfort with git-based workflows: branch, PR, review, CI
Clear written communication, with a strong command of the English language
The instinct to ask for help at the right time
Authorized to work in the U.S. or Canada
Preferred
Exposure to microservices, Docker, or cloud platforms (AWS)
Automated testing experience
Any background in finance, brokerage, trading, or blockchain. Genuine curiosity counts more than credentials here
Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar
Benefits
Health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
Stock options
Competitive vacation time, paid sick days, and time off for observed federal holidays
Equipment provided
